verdict.rationale: Linear documents filtered views that can be shared by URL (linear-docs-13), and its integrations directory lists building custom dashboards and analytics from issue and project data (linear-docs-84). However, that dashboard capability appears to be an external integration fed by API data, not widgets rendered inside Linear. Nothing in the evidence shows a UI-extension SDK or a way to embed custom components in Linear's interface. Missing for 10: a first-party UI extension or widget framework, the ability to embed custom dashboard widgets inside Linear, design-system or native styling guidance, and independent corroboration.
